Sample.evidence_source: This research aimed to explore the lived experiences of the process of suicide from the perspectives of people who had attempted suicide, their 'significant others', and people bereaved by suicide.

Population.evidence_source: This research aimed to explore the lived experiences of the process of suicide from the perspectives of people who had attempted suicide, their 'significant others', and people bereaved by suicide.

Type.evidence_source: This research aimed to explore the lived experiences of the process of suicide from the perspectives of people who had attempted suicide, their 'significant others', and people bereaved by suicide. The study utilised grounded theory method (GTM), to move beyond the descriptive to a more abstract, explanatory level, in this case to develop an explanation of suicidal behaviour based on descriptions of the lived experiences of the process of suicide.
